messages.author: 4fe26caaac11aa72
messages.subject: Re: CFA measurement invariance categorical data
parts:
Dear Cyrille,

the models fitG1 and fitG4 are the same in terms of df and x^2 compared to their counterparts in the table given by measurementInvarianceCat.
However, model fitG2 has a different X^2 statistics and model fitG4 differs in both X^2 & df. Thus, obviously you are comparing different models.

In addition, please note, that several researchers would argue that fit.loadings is not applicable in the categorical case, since thresholds and factor loadings have to be varied in tandem. Thus, you have to compare the configural invariance with the scalar invariance model directly.

Kind regards
Ulrich
